note: What a client sends as it leaves. It carries nothing of its own.

revisions.note: A client sends it once, as it leaves play without a result: as its player confirms quitting or closes the window in play, as its player declines or cancels reconnecting, or as its player dismisses the notice that the reconnection failed or that it was dropped for being away. It sends none after GameEnded.

A client sends it once, as it leaves play without a result: as its player confirms quitting or closes the window in play, as its player declines or cancels reconnecting, or as its player dismisses the notice that the reconnection failed or that it was dropped for being away.

A client sends it once, as it leaves without a result: as its player quits or closes the window, declines to reconnect or cancels a reconnection under way, or dismisses the notice that it was disconnected for being away or could not reconnect. After GameEnded, leaving the end screen sends none, but closing the window there sends it.

A client sends it once, as it leaves without a result while the match runs: as its player quits from the options menu or closes the window, declines to reconnect or cancels a reconnection under way, or dismisses the notice that it was disconnected for being away or could not reconnect. It sends none for GameEnded.
A client sends it as it leaves as one abandoning the match: as its player confirms quitting, closes the window or declines to reconnect.
A client sends it as it leaves as one abandoning the match: as its player confirms quitting, closes the window or declines to reconnect.

A client sends it as it leaves as one abandoning the match: as its player confirms quitting, closes the window or declines to reconnect, or as a reconnection fails, and as it leaves on a GameEnded that arrives while it loads with no champion of its own. Leaving a finished match sends none.
A client sends it as it leaves as one abandoning the match while the match runs: as its player confirms quitting or closes the window, declines to reconnect.
A client sends it as it leaves as one abandoning the match while the match runs: as its player confirms quitting or closes the window, declines to reconnect.

A client sends it as it leaves as one abandoning the match while the match runs: as its player confirms quitting or closes the window, declines to reconnect, or dismisses the notice that a reconnection failed or that it was dropped for being away. Closing the window before the match runs ends the client without it.

A client sends it as it leaves as one abandoning the match while the match runs: as its player confirms quitting or closes the window, declines to reconnect, or dismisses the notice that a reconnection failed or that it was dropped for being away.

A client sends it as its player picks End Game from the menu, as the window is closed (after the match has ended too), as its player turns down reconnecting, and as its player confirms the notice that it was dropped for being away or that a reconnection failed. It sends none as it leaves from the screen that ends the match, or for GameEnded arriving while the match still loads.
